title: Youth of the Future / شباب المستقبل
logline: An Ethiopian boy born in Riyadh in 2001 learns Arabic from the opening songs of Spacetoon cartoons, and grows up to make a cartoon of his own.
audience: People who grew up in the Gulf and Arab world in the 2000s (the Spacetoon generation), especially children of migrant families who learned Arabic from TV.
intent: Warm nostalgia first, then quiet pride: two homes, one childhood, and the promise of 'the youth of the future' coming true.

style.block: warm soft 2D storybook illustration, gouache texture, gentle brushstrokes, warm lamp light at home, cool blue TV glow, nostalgic early-2000s Riyadh apartment, consistent character design
style.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, text, letters, logos, brand names, existing cartoon characters, distorted hands, extra limbs, harsh lighting

characters.description: an anonymous 8-year-old Ethiopian boy, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, round face, striped red and white t-shirt, blue shorts
the same boy grown up, an anonymous 25-year-old Ethiopian man, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, short beard, plain dark blue hoodie
only the hands of an Ethiopian mother, warm brown skin, a thin gold bracelet, white cotton sleeve with a woven coloured border, no face shown
only the dark silhouette of a father standing in a lit doorway, tall, carrying a work bag, no face visible

voice.name: Charon
voice.style: Speak in a warm, slow, gentle, nostalgic tone, like a young man remembering his childhood

music.caption: gentle nostalgic instrumental, soft oud and warm synth pads, light hand percussion, a simple playful music-box motif, slow, no vocals, no strong lead under the voice

cues.does: the music-box motif appears, a little wonder
drops back to warm pads for the evening
the motif returns, fuller, and resolves at the end

shots.reason: Establish where and when: Riyadh, 2001, a city that is home but not the parents' country.
shots.image_prompt: Riyadh apartment rooftops at dusk in the early 2000s, many satellite dishes on the roofs, a minaret in the distance, orange and purple sky, warm lights in the windows
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in over the rooftops
shots.narration: وُلدتُ في الرياض، سنة ألفين وواحد، بعيدًا عن بلد أبي وأمي.
shots.subtitle: I was born in Riyadh in 2001, far from my parents' country.

shots.reason: The Ethiopian home through its strongest sense: food and smell.
shots.image_prompt: close view of the mother's hands pouring batter in a spiral onto a large round clay griddle to make injera, steam rising, a small bowl of red berbere spice and a pot of shiro beside it, warm kitchen light
shots.motion_prompt: steam rises slowly, the hand moves in a circle
shots.narration: في البيت كنا نتكلم الأمهرية، ورائحة الإنجيرا والبربري تملأ المكان.
shots.subtitle: At home we spoke Amharic, and the smell of injera and berbere filled the air.

shots.reason: The daily ritual starts: school is over and the boy runs to the TV.
shots.image_prompt: the boy running into a cosy Riyadh living room with floor cushions and a patterned carpet, dropping his school backpack, reaching for an old boxy CRT television on a low wooden stand
shots.motion_prompt: the boy runs in from the left, camera follows gently
shots.narration: بعد المدرسة، كنت أركض إلى الصالة، وأشغّل التلفاز.
shots.subtitle: After school, I ran to the salon and turned on the TV.

shots.reason: The slogan the whole film hangs on, heard through a child's face.
shots.image_prompt: close view of the boy's face lit by cool blue and colourful light from a television, eyes wide with wonder, small smile, dark room behind him
shots.motion_prompt: the TV light flickers softly on his face, slow push in
shots.subtitle: Spacetoon... the channel of the youth of the future.

shots.reason: The child's imagination: each cartoon felt like visiting another world.
shots.image_prompt: the boy sitting on a floor cushion in front of the glowing TV while simple glowing invented planets of different colours float around the living room above him, stars and soft light, dreamlike
shots.motion_prompt: planets drift and rotate slowly around the room
shots.narration: كل رسوم متحركة كانت كوكبًا جديدًا، وكنت أسافر إليها وحدي.
shots.subtitle: Every cartoon was a new planet, and I travelled there alone.

shots.reason: The heart of the story: how he really learned Arabic.
shots.image_prompt: the boy standing in front of the TV singing happily with his arms open, mouth wide open in song, colourful light from the screen, the living room around him
shots.motion_prompt: the boy sways and sings, light pulses with the music
shots.narration: حفظتُ العربية من الشارات، أغنيةً بعد أغنية.
shots.subtitle: I learned Arabic from the opening songs, one song after another.

shots.reason: The outside world: Saudi friends, Saudi food, the same songs.
shots.image_prompt: the boy sitting on a carpet with two Saudi boys in white thobes, sharing a large round tray of kabsa rice with chicken and a plate of dates, laughing together, warm afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: the boys laugh and reach for the food
shots.narration: وفي الخارج، أكلنا الكبسة مع أصدقائي، وغنّينا الشارات نفسها.
shots.subtitle: Outside, my friends and I shared kabsa and sang the same songs.

shots.reason: The warmth of home: the whole day leads to dad coming home.
shots.image_prompt: evening in the living room, warm lamp light, a round tray of injera on a low table, the boy turning his head with a happy face toward the front door as it opens and the father's dark silhouette stands in the bright doorway
shots.motion_prompt: the door opens slowly, light spills into the room
shots.narration: وفي المساء، كنا ننتظر صوت مفتاح أبي في الباب.
shots.subtitle: And every evening, we waited for the sound of Dad's key in the door.

shots.reason: The jump to today: same glow on the face, a different screen.
shots.image_prompt: the young man sitting at a desk at night, his face lit by the cool blue glow of a laptop screen, the same expression of wonder as the boy, a small modern room
shots.motion_prompt: slow push in on his face, screen light flickers
shots.subtitle: They called us the youth of the future.

shots.reason: The promise kept: the boy he was now lives inside the cartoon he made.
shots.image_prompt: over-the-shoulder view of the young man at his laptop, on the laptop screen a small illustrated picture of the boy singing in front of an old TV, warm light from a lamp, glowing invented planets reflected on the window
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull back from the laptop screen
shots.narration: وكانوا على حق. اليوم، أصنع الرسوم المتحركة بنفسي.
shots.subtitle: They were right. Today, I make the cartoons myself.

lines: Images, voice and music made with AI
A true story from my childhood in Riyadh
